name: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening

achievements.name: Meet Marin
achievements.detail: Wake in Mabe Village and meet Marin.

achievements.name: Toronbo Sword
achievements.detail: Take your shield from Tarin, then pick up your sword on Toronbo Shores.

achievements.name: Tail Cave
achievements.detail: Clear Tail Cave and take the Full Moon Cello.

achievements.name: Power Bracelet
achievements.detail: Find the Power Bracelet in Bottle Grotto.

achievements.name: Wind Fish Ballad
achievements.detail: Learn the Ballad of the Wind Fish from Marin.

achievements.name: Magnifying Lens
achievements.detail: Finish the trading sequence and receive the Magnifying Lens.

achievements.name: Koholint Sword
achievements.detail: Bring forty secret seashells to the Seashell Mansion and claim the Koholint Sword.

achievements.name: Eight Instruments
achievements.detail: Collect all eight Instruments of the Sirens.

achievements.name: Color Dungeon
achievements.detail: Clear the Color Dungeon and leave with the Red Mail or the Blue Mail.

achievements.name: Chamber Dungeon
achievements.detail: Arrange a Chamber Dungeon at Dampé's shack and clear it.

achievements.name: Wind Fish's Egg
achievements.detail: Play the Ballad of the Wind Fish and enter the Wind Fish's Egg.

achievements.name: Last Battle
achievements.detail: Win the battle at the end of the Wind Fish's Egg and see the ending.
